text:
Alex W: Quick quota ask for two onboarding tenants. Regions: eu-west-2 (London) and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore). Need p5 + g5 capacity, larger ENI and subnet IP limits, and placement-group headroom. Filing ticket now.
Mira K: Please post exact counts per region and account IDs so I can attach to the support case. AWS often wants per-instance-family and per-AZ breakdown.
Alex W: Account IDs: 555566667777 (EU-lon), 888899990000 (APAC-sg). Per-region request:
- eu-west-2: 5 x p5 (p5.48xlarge equiv), 10 x g5
- ap-southeast-1: 7 x p5, 6 x g5
Also request: network interfaces quota -> 2500, per-AZ subnet IP increase (we'll add secondary /20s), and placement-group cluster capacity for low-latency bundles. EFA-capable checks for p5 as well.
Raj P: Are we doing ENI trunking on p5/g5 or just standard ENIs? Trunking changes required ENI-per-instance expectations and AWS sometimes wants separate quota lines per AZ.
Alex W: Mix: default ENIs for most workloads, trunking on p5 for throughput tests, and EFA enabled for MPI-like experiments. Add NAT gateway throughput bump as a precaution in the ticket.
Infra Bot: [support-case created] Case# 7766554433 — "Quota increase: p5/g5 + ENI + EFA + placement-group capacity — eu-west-2 / ap-southeast-1". AWS initial severity: Low; reply ETA 24-72h.
Mira K: Upload AMI/driver details to justify EFA/placement usage. Which AMI + drivers?
Alex W: AMI: rwl-infer-2026-03 (CUDA 12.2, Nvidia driver 555.98, NCCL 2.18). Bootstrapping via userdata; sample:
```
#!/bin/bash
/opt/redwood/bootstrap.sh --register --pool gpu-p5 --enable-efa
```
Timeline: need 2 p5 + 3 g5 in eu-west-2 within 48h for smoke runs; remainder within 5 business days. Fallback is to route through our dedicated us-east-1 pool if EU capacity isn't available.
Lina S: Cost quick-check — estimate p5 ~ $34/hr, g5 ~ $11/hr in those regions. If everything were up concurrently that's ~ $5xx/hr. Recommend staged ramp (start at 20-30%) and strict budget alerts. I'll set the autoscaler caps.
Raj P: I'll pre-create placement-group names and secondary /20 subnets in each AZ so we can boot immediately once quotas land. Also prepping a small script to verify ENI counts, EFA devices, and NIC numbering post-boot.
Mira K: Good. Also add justification doc for latency-sensitive inference (99p tail latency targets) to the support case — AWS often approves placement quotas with clear perf rationale.
Infra Bot: [case update] Case# 7766554433 — AWS requested additional justification for placement-group capacity in ap-southeast-1. Uploaded latency tests + onboarding schedule.
Alex W: Thanks. I'll keep this thread updated with AWS ETA and CR numbers. Ping me if you need edits to the justification. :thumbsup:
